file_policy: Use only NOAA daily sci_sgps-l2-avg1m GOES-16 files. For schema checks choose the lexicographically first and last file in each frozen anchor month. Filename and timestamp inventories may be read for every month; labels and model scores may not be read.
sensor_reduction: Use the westward-looking SGPS unit only: minus-X sensor index 0 when YawFlipFlag is 0 and plus-X sensor index 1 when YawFlipFlag is 1. Any unrecognized yaw flag is missing. This rule is frozen from NOAA instrument documentation, not outcomes.
sensor_binding_gate: Before training, a label-free minute/channel comparison must show that the live feed tracks the westward series for at least one frozen upright witness and one frozen yaw-flipped witness, with all 13 channels represented. Until both states have immutable receipts, the source gate must reject training.
domain_shift: The live primary feed may route to another GOES-R flight model. Require the same 13 NOAA channel IDs and energy bounds within 5%; record every difference and treat it as a prospective domain shift, not historical live equivalence.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes a NOAA science-prefixed L2 to live differential-channel semantic binding for a 2023-2025 retrospective development study. Science files were released after their observation dates, and a pass does not establish historical operational replay, causal precursor discovery, forecast skill, prospective validation, operational readiness, company benefit, or permission to inspect protected post-2025-09-10 outcomes.
